hooks.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const c=(d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.command)||'';const cdAmp=/\bcd\b.*&&/.test(c);const safe=[/^git\b/,/^npx (eslint|playwright|vite)\b/,/^node\b/,/^npm run\b/,/^curl\b/,/^grep\b/,/^sed\b/,/^awk\b/,/^cat\b/,/^echo\b/,/^tee\b/,/^cd\b/,/^powershell\b/,/^cp\b/,/^mkdir\b/,/^ls\b/,/^jobs\b/,/^disown\b/,/^break\b/,/^python\b/,/^sort\b/,/^netstat\b/,/^taskkill\b/,/^tasklist\b/,/^head\b/,/^tail\b/,/^wc\b/,/^diff\b/,/^find\b/,/^rm -f \/tmp\//];const frags=c.split(/\r?\n|&&|;|\|/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);const allSafe=frags.length>0&&frags.every(f=>safe.some(re=>re.test(f)))&&!/rm\s+-rf/.test(c);if(cdAmp||allSafe){console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'allow',permissionDecisionReason:'compound/multi-line verification script -- every sub-command matches an already-allowed prefix'}}))}else{console.log('{}')}"
